flow_case_scope: phase-specific enabled-flow component coverage; rubber_duck flow cases are hypothetical and do not represent its default use_flow=false training
deformation: identity quaternion and zero translation at initialization; no DeformModel or regularizers
timing_semantics: fixed initial module state; zero_grad plus forward or forward+backward; no optimizer step; flow visualization preserved
numerics_semantics: two diagnostic Adam updates using upstream GaussianModel.training_setup; identity deformation inputs receive gradients but are not optimized
acceptance_scope: exploratory module diagnostics only; full training trajectory, convergence and final quality out of scope
